title: LuckRead Subscription D1-01 Logical Persistence Contract

authority.workerRuntimeBoundary: W07 Subscription workflow with explicitly admitted D1-01 access transition; W02 remains D1-01 Identity/Account/Access authority owner.

table.name: membership_subscriptions
table.purpose: Authoritative durable Subscription lifecycle state for Membership/Subscription access.

constraints.subscriptionIdUnique: subscription_id is the primary key and is never reused.
constraints.subscriberReference: subscriber_id references authoritative ENT-USER by stable identifier only; no cross-D1 physical foreign key.
constraints.planVersionReference: plan_id + plan_version identifies the immutable plan definition consumed by the subscription.
constraints.financialIsolation: No payment, order, ledger, wallet or settlement facts are persisted as Subscription authority.
constraints.entitlementIsolation: entitlement_snapshot_ref is a reference only; Entitlement remains its own authority.
constraints.privacy: subscriber_id is not a public identifier and must be exposed only through authorized scoped APIs.
constraints.versionMonotonic: version starts at 1 and increments exactly once per successful authoritative mutation.

concurrency.apiBoundary: If-Match / expected-version semantics from Membership API contract.
concurrency.decision: The Subscription entity field contract now defines version as the authoritative concurrency source. If-Match/expectedVersion MUST compare-and-set against this field; ETag remains representation metadata only.

uniqueness.reason: Membership Data Contract requires prevention of duplicate active subscriptions where business policy requires it, but the authoritative policy does not yet define whether the business key is subscriber-only, subscriber+plan, creator scope, organization scope, or another combination.
uniqueness.rule: No speculative unique constraint may be introduced until the applicable Membership policy/plan scope contract resolves the active-subscription uniqueness boundary.

migration.rule: The version-column migration is prepared as a reviewed code candidate only. A physical migration still requires exact artifact hash, read-only confirmation of the target and migration history, controlled target D1-01 execution and post-schema evidence.

runtime.scheduledPlanChange: W07 D1-01 durable schedule; activation only through verified paid-renewal D1-04 -> D1-01 outcome sync; no scheduler activation is implied
runtime.immediatePlanUpgrade: W07 creates a prorated D1-04 Order from authoritative immutable plan versions; only the verified successful Hyperswitch webhook may create the one-use D1-01 application proof and CAS the existing Subscription plan without resetting the paid billing period.
runtime.membershipTrialLifecycle: W07 manages trial start and verified source reconciliation in the existing W07 runtime. D1-01 membership_subscription_trials is the immutable trial lifecycle ledger; membership_subscriptions remains the only access/period authority. WEB starts require an ACTIVE D1-04 Hyperswitch MIT mandate joined to a saved payment method; App Store and Play Store start/conversion/cancellation/expiry are only materialized from W02-verified RevenueCat current-customer snapshots. WEB first charge reuses the existing D1-04 renewal-cycle, order/payment and Hyperswitch MIT flow at current_period_end.

forbidden: Add a second Subscription authority in D1-04.
Store payment-provider secrets or raw payment credentials.
Create a speculative active-subscription uniqueness constraint.
Introduce a standalone version field without a field-contract change.
Treat cache, projection or analytics data as Subscription authority.
Execute or claim migration success from this logical contract.
Apply a scheduled target plan before the corresponding renewal Payment is verified successful.
Store scheduled plan-change authority in D1-04 or in a projection.
Apply an immediate upgrade or grant target-plan entitlement before a verified successful Hyperswitch payment webhook.

migration artifact hash
schema inspection proving all 14 columns and nullability
index inspection
no cross-D1 foreign-key evidence
W07 runtime binding evidence
optimistic-lock source binding evidence
active-subscription uniqueness policy decision
Subscription runtime positive/duplicate/cancel/pause/resume/change-plan evidence
Evidence Registry record tied to validating commit SHA
migration lineage includes 0003 MembershipPlan, 0004 RevenueCat product bindings, and 0005 scheduled plan changes in order
scheduled plan-change table schema, three indexes, seven table triggers, and one Subscription plan-write guard are verified by read-only D1-01 postflight
positive, idempotent replay, conflicting idempotency, downgrade, interval change, failed-renewal retry, paid-application, pause/cancel cancellation, and direct-plan-write rejection evidence
D1-01 migration 0006 immediate-upgrade application table, four indexes, seven application triggers, and replacement Subscription plan-write guard are verified by read-only postflight

Immediate upgrade proof binds the same subscriber, source/target immutable plan versions, Subscription version, unchanged billing period and D1-04 order/payment references; paid amount and currency are verified from D1-04 only
Only an authenticated/authorized W01 request may create an idempotent prorated D1-04 order; no client-supplied price or amount is admitted
Only a signed successful Hyperswitch webhook may apply the immediate upgrade; duplicate webhook delivery returns the already-applied result without changing Subscription again
Failed or pending payment leaves the source Subscription plan and entitlements unchanged
D1-01 insert guards reject a scheduled plan-change record while an immediate upgrade reservation is PENDING_PAYMENT/READY and reject a new upgrade reservation while a scheduled change is active.

D1-01 migration 0007 adds immutable membership_plan_versions.trial_days with integer range 0..90, membership_subscription_trials exact 16-column schema, four indexes and nine triggers; exact migration lineage 0001 through 0007 must be verified read-only after the future deployment
WEB trial start requires an ACTIVE D1-04 Hyperswitch MIT mandate and saved method bound to the subscriber; D1-01 atomically creates Subscription TRIALING and trial record

App Store/Play Store trials are created and reconciled only from W02-verified RevenueCat customer snapshots using immutable product bindings and initial store transaction identity; client/webhook bodies cannot assert trial state
TRIALING entitlement is limited to current_period_start <= now < current_period_end; cancel_at at trial end suppresses conversion but retains access to the end

Verified successful first Hyperswitch MIT charge or W02-verified RevenueCat paid period converts the same Subscription to ACTIVE and trial to CONVERTED, including recovery from PAST_DUE or a payment already submitted before cancellation

Failed first web MIT charge moves Subscription to PAST_DUE and trial to PAYMENT_FAILED; bounded retries preserve the exact cycle and mandate; a subscriber may cancel while PAYMENT_FAILED to prevent new retries.
Canceled web trial with an in-flight submitted/uncertain payment is not expired before terminal outcome reconciliation; unpaid canceled trial expires at trial_ends_at
Trial start and cancellation require W01, W08 owner-scoped CASL permission, and durable W06 intent/result audit
A MembershipPlan immutable version with trial_days > 0 must have price_minor > 0; both W07 validation and D1-01 migration 0007 enforce this invariant.
promotionRule: Remain CONTRACTED_NOT_VERIFIED until the physical binding, migration, runtime authority and Evidence Registry evidence are all admitted.

scheduledPlanChangeTable.name: membership_subscription_plan_changes
scheduledPlanChangeTable.purpose: Immutable source/target plan identity and durable scheduling state for a subscriber plan change. The schedule remains in D1-01 and is applied only by the verified paid renewal outcome that advances the authoritative Subscription period.

constraints.authority: D1-01 only; D1-04 stores immutable renewal-cycle offer snapshots, never a second scheduled-change authority.
constraints.oneScheduledChangePerSubscription: A partial unique index allows at most one SCHEDULED change for a Subscription.
constraints.sourceAndTarget: Source and target plan versions reference immutable membership_plan_versions in the same D1-01 database.
constraints.effectiveBoundary: effective_at equals the source Subscription current_period_end; target price and billing interval are used only for the next renewal cycle.
constraints.paidActivation: Only a verified successful Hyperswitch renewal outcome may CAS the Subscription to the target plan and advance the paid period; the same D1-01 transaction changes SCHEDULED to APPLIED.
constraints.failedRenewal: A failed renewal preserves the source plan and SCHEDULED record while Subscription transitions to PAST_DUE.
constraints.cancellation: Pause, cancellation, expiration, or a non-null cancel_at cancels a pending plan change.
constraints.noEarlyEntitlement: Scheduling a downgrade never changes current plan fields or current entitlement.
constraints.idempotency: change_id is deterministic from subscriber and idempotency key; request_hash rejects reuse with a different semantic request.
constraints.versioning: Every schedule status update increments version exactly once and advances updated_at.

paidPlanUpgradeApplicationTable.name: membership_subscription_plan_change_applications
paidPlanUpgradeApplicationTable.purpose: A single active D1-01 upgrade-checkout reservation and one-use application proof. PENDING_PAYMENT reserves the existing Subscription while its D1-04 Order awaits customer-present payment; a verified successful Hyperswitch webhook attaches the D1-04 Payment reference and transitions through READY to APPLIED. Financial amount and currency remain exclusively authoritative in D1-04.
paidPlanUpgradeApplicationTable.authority: D1-01 stores the guarded plan transition proof only; D1-04 remains authoritative for Order, Payment, paid amount, currency and provider references.

constraints.sourceAndTarget: Source and target must be immutable versions of creator-owned plans from the same creator, same currency and billing interval; target list price must be higher.
constraints.subscriptionCas: The source plan/version, subscriber, Subscription version and current paid period must exactly match when the checkout reservation is created and at the subsequent CAS update.
constraints.paymentEvidence: order_id and payment_id are references to D1-04 facts. A PENDING_PAYMENT reservation has a null payment_id and blocks any second active upgrade checkout for that Subscription. W07 verifies the succeeded Payment amount/currency against the confirmed Order in D1-04 before attaching the Payment reference and transitioning the reservation to READY; D1-01 does not copy financial facts.
constraints.immediateActivation: A same-period Subscription plan update is permitted only while an exact READY application proof exists with a verified payment_id. The Subscription update and READY -> APPLIED transition are in one D1-01 batch.
constraints.noPeriodReset: Immediate upgrade preserves current_period_start and current_period_end; it does not add days or create a duplicate Subscription.
constraints.idempotency: Unique Order and Payment references, one active reservation per Subscription, and deterministic application_id prevent parallel upgrade orders and provider webhook replay from applying a second upgrade.
constraints.retention: Application identity is immutable apart from the one-time null payment_id attachment during PENDING_PAYMENT -> READY; status is PENDING_PAYMENT -> READY -> APPLIED only; application history cannot be deleted.
constraints.mutualExclusion: A PENDING_PAYMENT or READY upgrade reservation and a SCHEDULED downgrade/billing-interval change cannot coexist for the same Subscription. D1-01 insert guards enforce the exclusion in both write directions to close concurrent request races.

constraints.meaning: Number of free-trial days offered by this exact immutable plan version. Zero disables WEB trial start; existing subscriptions retain the version they started on.
constraints.positivePrice: Any immutable plan version with trial_days greater than zero must also have price_minor greater than zero; trial starts cannot be offered against a zero-price plan with no payable conversion.

membershipSubscriptionTrialTable.name: membership_subscription_trials
membershipSubscriptionTrialTable.purpose: D1-01 authoritative, immutable trial provenance and lifecycle for an existing Subscription. No payment amounts or provider credentials are stored here.

constraints.authority: D1-01 only; D1-04 owns order/payment/mandate/renewal-cycle facts.
constraints.subscriptionLink: Exactly one trial record per subscription; subscription, subscriber, creator plan and immutable plan version must match at insert.
constraints.sourceBinding: WEB records have no store identifiers; APP_STORE and PLAY_STORE require the verified RevenueCat app ID, product ID and the first observed store_transaction_id. Later RevenueCat renewal snapshots may expose new store transaction IDs; W07 matches the existing trial by verified subscriber, app, immutable plan and product without overwriting the first transaction ID.
constraints.webTrialStart: A WEB trial can be inserted only if the immutable plan version has trial_days 1..90 and an active D1-04 Hyperswitch MIT mandate is bound to the same subscriber.
constraints.storeTrialStart: Store trial rows are written only after W02 identity verification and RevenueCat current-customer snapshot/product binding reconciliation.
constraints.accessBoundary: Subscription current_period_start/current_period_end and status TRIALING control access. cancel_at equal to trial_ends_at suppresses conversion but does not revoke access early.
constraints.paymentConversion: WEB conversion is only through verified Hyperswitch first MIT renewal outcome sync; store conversion is from the verified RevenueCat NORMAL paid-period snapshot.
constraints.failedPayment: A failed WEB first charge changes Subscription to PAST_DUE and linked trial to PAYMENT_FAILED. Retry uses the same D1-04 cycle and mandate.
constraints.cancellationRace: If the first payment was already submitted before cancellation, verified success may transition CANCELED to CONVERTED; otherwise canceled trial expires at trial_ends_at.
constraints.expiry: WEB trial expiry is scheduled by existing W07 renewal batch only after pending provider outcomes are reconciled. Store expiry is reconciled from RevenueCat current-customer snapshot; the access period end still blocks access when reached.
constraints.idempotency: WEB trial ID is deterministic from subscriber and Idempotency-Key. Store trial ID is deterministic from source, RevenueCat app ID and first observed store transaction ID; later transaction IDs are reconciled to the existing subscriber/plan/product trial without replacing immutable provenance.
constraints.retention: Trial identity/history cannot be deleted; state updates require version increment and increasing updated_at.
constraints.cancellation: A WEB trial in TRIALING or PAYMENT_FAILED may be canceled using If-Match. Subscription.cancel_at is set to trial_ends_at without changing the current TRIALING/PAST_DUE state; D1-01 transitions the trial row to CANCELED. This stops new retries but preserves current-period access. If a payment was already submitted, its verified success may still convert CANCELED to CONVERTED.
constraints.retry: A failed WEB first charge moves Subscription to PAST_DUE and linked trial to PAYMENT_FAILED. Retry uses the same D1-04 cycle and mandate; if the subscriber cancels while PAYMENT_FAILED, no new retry is prepared.
